summary: Improves chat controls and background task scheduling, refines Proxy and update panels, and includes a framework security update.

items.title: Model and agent menus
items.description: Both selectors now open above the sidebar and chats, stay attached to their buttons during resizing, and support search, selection, Escape, and the thinking submenu.

items.title: Chat input controls
items.description: The normal input uses one button for Live, Stop, and Send, including steering. The live typing bar shows Send only and enables it when connected with text ready to send.

items.title: Update panel order
items.description: The latest version, status, and update actions appear first, followed by What’s New.

items.title: Sub-agent scheduling
items.description: Up to five sub-agents can execute at once. Stopped, completed, and historical workers no longer take slots; paused workers release slots at a safe boundary, and resumed workers wait for capacity. Slot counts use worker IDs, with follow-up cleanup races and queued-state display corrected.

items.title: Proxy in side chats
items.description: Scrollbars stay at the far-right edge, the Proxy card and turn rail have more clearance, model and send controls are consistent, and floating menus stay within their pane.

items.title: Sub-agent resume status
items.description: Resumed sub-agents retain their reported queued, waiting, or paused status in chat.

items.title: Framework security update
items.description: EterX now uses a patched stable release of Next.js.
